newsitem.title: UK: U.N. says agrees aid plan details with Iraq.
newsitem.headline: U.N. says agrees aid plan details with Iraq.

text.p: The United Nations in Baghdad said on Monday it had finalised talks with Iraq on a food distribution plan.
"We have successfully concluded discussions in Baghdad about the new national distribution plan," Staffan De Mistura, U.N. co-ordinator in Baghdad, told Reuters by telephone.
"The text now needs to be finalised and translated into Arabic," said De Mistura.
"We believe the whole process will be concluded by next Monday, including the official submission by the government of Iraq to the Secretary-General of the United Nations," he added.
He declined to speculate when oil sales from Iraq might resume.
Baghdad has made the completion of an aid hand-out accord a condition for restarting crude exports under the second term of its oil-for-food deal with the United Nations.
